verdict.rationale: Rippling documents extensive autonomous background automations—real-time provisioning/deprovisioning, custom workflows triggering on security/device events, AI-triggered offboarding retrieval flows, and agent-driven device lifecycle management—that run without manual intervention. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of these automations working reliably in practice, and clearer detail on user-configurable automation builder UI versus fixed system behaviors.
